name: page-header
title: Page Header
description: The standardized header at the top of a page — back button, breadcrumb trail, title, description, actions, secondary menu, and a favorite star.

meta.whenToUse: The header band at the top of a page — title plus back/breadcrumb nav, actions, favorite.
meta.whenNotToUse: App-shell chrome (top nav/sidebar) or a section heading inside a page.
